## Session Starting

<@&1555281818935103568> <@&1555281551028125836>

A session is now starting in **Los Angeles State Roleplay**. All members wishing to participate should begin preparing and ensure they are ready to join.

Please follow all server rules, listen to staff instructions, and maintain a high standard of roleplay throughout the session.

We look forward to seeing you in the session!
